items.excerpt: Walt Disney is moving toward thousands of job cuts with the entertainment giant asking some managers to target 20% in annual cost savings, according to people familiar with the matter. items.headline: Firm Tied to Some OpenAI, Anthropic AI Hacks Blames ‘Error’
items.excerpt: A spate of cyberattacks involving AI agents from some of the world’s top model makers were down to a human error and time pressures at Israeli security company Irregular Security, according to Chief Executive Officer Dan Lahav.

items.headline: Goldman Limits Traders and Bankers From Using Some AI Tools
items.excerpt: Goldman Sachs has annoyed some employees by curbing their access to certain AI tools. Nicole Sy explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Match Drops After Sales, Profit Outlook Miss Estimates
items.excerpt: Match Group Inc. disappointed investors after posting weaker-than-expected quarterly revenue and forecasting adjusted earnings that missed Wall Street estimates, suggesting it still has work to do in pulling off a long-promised turnaround.

items.headline: Meta Seeks $15 Billion in First Leg of Cross-Border Fundraising
items.excerpt: Meta Platforms Inc. is selling debt for the first time in six months, offering investors juicier yields as it seeks to lure buyers despite growing skepticism over Big Tech’s massive bet on artificial intelligence.

items.headline: Google Parent Plans $1.5 Billion Prepaid Energy Deal via Goldman
items.excerpt: Google parent Alphabet Inc. is back in the municipal bond market for the second time this year with a $1.5 billion prepaid energy deal.

items.headline: Midterms Threaten to Upend a Trump-Era Financial Market Order
items.excerpt: The second Trump administration has created a boon for a relatively new crop of financial companies in the digital finance industry. Some traders are positioning for that to change after Tuesday’s US midterm vote.

items.headline: Quant Trader’s Criminal Trial to Spotlight Secretive Industry
items.excerpt: The criminal trial of a quantitative trader for allegedly stealing algorithmic trading code will also put a spotlight on the secretive industry in which he worked.

items.headline: Binance Hackers Used Fake Job Interviews in Record Heist
items.excerpt: Binance Holdings Ltd. said Tuesday that the hackers behind a $6.3 billion heist used social engineering techniques including fake job interviews, as well as malicious software, in the most detailed report yet on how the incident unfolded.

items.headline: Palantir Outlook Signals Slowdown in AI-Fueled Sales Growth
items.excerpt: Palantir Technologies Inc., the AI-powered data and analytics platform that counts the US military among its chief customers, issued a quarterly outlook that pointed to a potential slowdown in sales growth.

items.headline: Shopify Plunges as Revenue Misses for First Time Since 2022
items.excerpt: Shopify Inc. shares sank after its quarterly revenue missed analysts’ expectations for the first time in four years.

items.headline: Goldman’s Molavi Says 60% of S&P 500 Is in Bear Market Territory
items.excerpt: The S&P 500 Index is within about 3% of its latest record high and yet 60% of the benchmark is languishing in bear market territory.

items.headline: AI Minister Says the UK Isn’t Ready for ‘Extremely Likely’ Cyber Attacks
items.excerpt: The UK is “extremely likely” to experience a serious cybersecurity breach in the near future, according to the country’s AI minister Kanishka Narayan.

items.excerpt: Palantir Technologies expects revenue of roughly $2.65 billion in the three months ended Dec. 31. items.headline: Energy Transfer Approves $1.6 Billion Gas Pipe as AI Use Soars
items.excerpt: Energy Transfer LP formally committed to building a $1.6 billion pipeline that will move natural gas from eastern Louisiana across Mississippi, a move that comes as data centers and export terminals boost demand for the fuel.
